create.name: Nicole Bayliss
create.bio:
Nicole Bayliss is an energy healer, soul coach and author who has run a private practice in Neutral Bay on Sydney's Lower North Shore for more than fifteen years. She trained at Nature Care College in Sydney through the late 2000s, gaining certificates in meditation, holistic life care and tarot and a diploma in holistic counselling, then went on to Reiki Master level, NLP teacher certification, the Forensic Healing system and past-life regression training with Brian Weiss.

In sessions, which she offers face to face in Sydney and online, she blends soul-level coaching with energy work, drawing on tarot and Akashic Records readings, chakra clearing, Reiki and work with ancestral and past-life patterns to help clients understand their life path and let go of limiting beliefs. Much of her teaching centres on universal laws, forgiveness and the spiritual side of money, love and work, themes that run through her seven self-published books, among them Soul Magic and The Money Matrix. On Insight Timer she shares guided meditations, affirmations and talks, holds monthly live sessions and offers courses on prosperity and on releasing fear and lack. She also sends a weekly email of guidance and keeps a library of free e-books on her site.

books.title: The Money Matrix

books.description: A short guide in twelve steps to the beliefs and habits that shape how money moves through a life. It pairs spiritual principles with practical reflection to shift from a scarcity mindset towards abundance.

courses.title: Personal Healing Sessions
courses.description: Sessions of 60 to 90 minutes in Neutral Bay or online, combining soul coaching with energy work such as Reiki, chakra clearing, tarot or Akashic Records guidance. Discounted packages of four or six sessions are available.

courses.title: Perfect Prosperity
courses.description: Her Insight Timer course on abundance as a spiritual practice, with talks and meditations on opening to flow in money and life.
courses.price: Included in Member Plus ($59.99 USD a year)

courses.title: Releasing Beliefs Of Fear And Lack
courses.description: A guided Insight Timer course for noticing and letting go of inherited beliefs about scarcity and not being enough.
courses.price: Included in Member Plus ($59.99 USD a year)

courses.title: Soul Magic
courses.description: The e-book edition of her book of short spiritual teachings, designed to be read straight through or opened at random as a daily oracle.

courses.title: 25 Universal Laws That Create Love, Peace, Joy and Abundance
courses.description: A compact e-book on the spiritual principles she sees behind a peaceful, abundant life, each explained with ways to apply it.

free_resources.title: Nicole Bayliss on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Guided meditations, affirmations and talks on love, flow and soul connection, free to hear, plus her monthly live sessions in the app.

free_resources.title: Who You Really Are Meditation
free_resources.description: A free guided inner journey you can play on her website, exploring the self beneath roles and stories.

free_resources.title: 7 Key Universal Laws That Can Change Your Life
free_resources.description: A free e-book sent on sign-up, introducing seven of the spiritual laws she teaches with simple ways to live by them.

free_resources.title: Pathway to Soul Connection
free_resources.description: A free guide on understanding the soul and deepening your connection with it, which she sees as the missing piece in manifesting.
